title: Bound smoke quality gates with fail-closed timeout
outOfScope: Publishing a tag or release asset

sources.reason: The smoke workflow runs make quality without a bounded job timeout and has stalled at that step.
Defines the repository quality gate command invoked by smoke.
Workflow regression tests provide deterministic coverage for the timeout contract.
Requires corrective workflow Work Items and complete PR lifecycle.
Records the observed CI process issue and corrective action.

riskAssessment.reason: A timeout must fail closed without weakening required quality gates or allowing a false green result.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized corrective Work Items; fix the stalled CI control before returning to PR #385.

preReviewWarnings: Timeout must be fail-closed, documented, and covered by workflow validation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The smoke job has an explicit bounded timeout that fails the job rather than skipping checks.
The timeout and its fail-closed intent are covered by a deterministic workflow test or validation.
The observed stalled smoke process is recorded in the remediation plan.
The complete Contract, verification, Summary, PR, CI, merge, close, branch cleanup, and main synchronization lifecycle passes.
guidelines: Do not weaken, skip, or reorder repository quality gates.
Workflow changes must remain reviewable and fail closed.

intent.problem: The required smoke workflow run for PR #385 stalled for many hours in make quality, leaving all later gates pending and preventing the governed Work Item lifecycle from closing.
constraints: Do not skip or weaken any quality gate.
A timeout must fail closed and expose diagnostics.
Keep publication and release assets out of scope.
intent.rationale: A bounded CI job prevents indefinite ambiguous state while preserving the rule that incomplete quality verification cannot be reported as passed.

rawUserRequest: If a process problem is found during a Work Item, record it and fix the process before continuing; continue the complete governed workflow without silently bypassing CI.

declaredIntent.summary: Bound the smoke workflow's repository quality step with a fail-closed timeout and preserve all downstream gates.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: quality gate completes within configured timeout
quality gate exceeds timeout and job fails closed

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized process correction before continuing the complete Work Item workflow.
